channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Explosion at HABAS steel mill in Izmir: death toll rises to 17
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: An explosion at the HABAS steel plant in Aliağa, Izmir killed 17 people; Turkish and Persian sources describe the cause differently. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Eight-count impeachment resolution against Hegseth introduced in Congress
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Republican congressman Massie filed an eight-count impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war crimes; vote set for Wednesday. (Source: Khabaronline (AP and CNN))

item.title: France blames IRGC for cyberattack on supermarket refrigerators
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: France attributed a cyberattack that disabled supermarket cooling systems to the IRGC; Iran's ambassador was summoned to Paris. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Turkish intelligence chief: Vance, Rezaei to meet in Qatar next week; Tehran denies
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Turkey's intelligence chief says VP Vance and Iran's security council secretary will meet in Qatar; IRGC-affiliated agency denies the claim. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Iran's parliament: 35% salary increase inadequate against 88% inflation
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Member of Iran's parliamentary Budget Committee says a proposed 35% public sector wage increase falls short against official 88% inflation. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Rubio: Iran's demands unacceptable; Trump hosts Qatar PM today on Iran tensions
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Rubio said negotiations with Iran show no progress; Trump is hosting Qatar's PM at White House today to discuss Iran tensions. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Trump tied election loss to Iran war; Democrats call for ending conflict
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to ISNA, Trump blamed his party's midterm losses on the Iran war and gas prices; a Democratic senator called for ending the conflict. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Second drone strike on Kor Mor gas field in same night
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iraq's Kor Mor gas field in same night hit by second drone strike; first attack cut 2,800 MW of power. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Houthis attack Riyadh with missiles and drones: Aramco building damaged, flights halted
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Yemeni Houthis struck Riyadh and eastern Saudi Arabia with missiles and drones; Aramco office damaged, no deaths reported. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Leaked letter: Oil trade allegedly routed to former official's son's shipping network
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iran International published leaked document alleging oil sales directed to former official's son's shipping network; claim unverified, single source. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Week's Frame (Nov 2-8): The blockade reaches land amid threats of attack
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Persian press Nov 2-8: post-election attack window, Kish strikes, CENTCOM land blockade, S-400 requests, hardening nuclear rhetoric. (Source: Farsçadan)

item.title: Larijani: 'Nuclear weapons can be used tactically against enemy military base'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Larijani said nuclear weapons shouldn't target civilians but can be used tactically against enemy military bases. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Two tankers caught fire in Hormuz: Iran said mine, U.S. claimed strike on blockade-breaking ship
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Two tankers exploded and caught fire in Strait of Hormuz; Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed a mine, U.S. said it struck a blockade-busting vessel. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: CENTCOM extends Iran blockade to land borders: 'Iron Gate' established
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Iran International, CENTCOM established 'Iron Gate' to block shipments of weapons and sanctioned goods to Iran via land borders and Caspian Sea. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Eisenkot, Netanyahu's rival, tasked with forming government in Israel
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Herzog tasked Netanyahu's fiercest rival, Gadi Eisenkot, with forming a new government; 67 Knesset members had nominated him. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Erdoğan-Trump phone call: U.S.-Iran tension should be resolved through diplomacy
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Khabaronline, Erdoğan told Trump in a phone call that U.S.-Iran tension must be resolved through diplomacy; the call also covered Ukraine. (Source: Khabaronline (Anadolu Agency))

item.title: Times claim of iodine tablets near nuclear facilities rejected by Health Ministry
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iran's Health Ministry spokesman denied The Times's claim that iodine tablets were distributed near nuclear sites; no ministry official granted interview. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Telegraph: Iran requested S-400 air defense from Putin during Rezai's Moscow visit
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Telegraph, Iran requested S-400 air defenses from Putin during Rezai's Moscow visit; leaked documents show Russian missile production for Iran. (Source: Ettelaat (via Telegraph))

item.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions eight Canada-based money exchangers serving Iran's regime
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned eight Canada-based money transfer firms serving Iran's regime under the Operation Economic Outcast campaign. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Al-Monitor: Erdoğan's Baku visit cannot mask Turkey-Azerbaijan tensions
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Al-Monitor reports that Erdoğan's visit to Baku for November 8 Victory Day may not overcome deeper Turkey-Azerbaijan tensions rooted in headscarf crisis. (Source: Khabaronline (via Al-Monitor))
